```python
import pyautogui
import time

# Focus location bar
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'l')
time.sleep(0.5)

# Type in our bill’s full path and confirm
pyautogui.typewrite('~/aws-bill.pdf')
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.5)

# Click the Open button
pyautogui.click(1228, 50)
```
